name: Marriage Contract
source:
"All rings come in pairs. Whoever bears the ring that resonates with yours - is your other half."

Thrown into a new undesired reality, where he is separated from his heart's choice, Mike now has to find a way to live through the painful days. It's up to him how to treat this enforced new life, what choices to make within it, and ultimately... whatever to accept it or to reject it.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23407]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
“所有的戒指都是成对出现的。谁拥有与你的戒指产生共鸣的戒指，谁就是你的另一半。”

迈克被抛入了一个新的、不受欢迎的现实，与自己内心的选择相分离，他现在必须找到一种方式来度过痛苦的日子。如何对待这个被迫的新生活，在其中做出什么选择，以及最终……无论是接受还是拒绝，都取决于他。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23407]引理软论坛[/url]]
